visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a professional television studio with overhead trusses and bright lights, a middle-aged man in a dark hoodie performs a plank exercise on the floor beside a table covered in a blue cloth. A woman in a red and black patterned jacket sits across from a tall wooden block tower, while a cameraman in a black jacket kneels in the background to film the scene. (2) The camera zooms into a close-up of the woman's hands as she delicately manipulates a wooden block near the top of the tower; she has a focused expression, wearing a silver watch and rings. The background features a red brick wall and studio equipment. (3) The scene cuts back to a medium shot as the woman successfully removes a block, causing the entire tower to wobble and then collapse onto the table. She reacts with a wide-mouthed scream of surprise and laughter, throwing her hands up, while the man in the background continues his plank and smiles toward the camera.
